# The Irvington Voice

> > The Irvington Voice is the official student newspaper of Irvington High School in California, featuring news, opinions, and entertainment coverage by student journalists.

The Irvington Voice serves as the primary news and editorial platform for Irvington High School, publishing student-written articles on school news, sports, entertainment, and student life. The publication maintains a dedicated staff of student journalists and editors who cover campus events and community issues.
